answer: Quadratic stake cost resists sybils: the collateral demanded to reach a given influence level rises with the SQUARE of that influence, so concentrated honest stake is efficient but buying weight is deliberately expensive at the top. Crucially this only holds WITH identity binding — absent it, splitting into many accounts each at the cheap low end would dodge the curve, so the mechanism REQUIRES one-identity-one-curve. Bound that way, a basalt-hard crystal wall of cost sits between an attacker and real sway, and the nadir of cheap mass influence is closed.
